title: Whats Sup
specs: SUP derived from Hawaiian beach boy surfing tradition
Combo adventure paddles Sammamish River to Lake Washington then bikes back
Must be 18 to rent; under 18 must have parent accompany on water
Must sign waiver and present ID to hold while on water
Children as young as 12 generally taught
Everyone must wear a PFD; provided for anyone 30 pounds and over
Dogs allowed under 25 lbs on SUP boards
Lessons instructed in small groups of 1 to 5 students
Can arrange special times for groups by email

blurb: Guests rent stand up paddle boards, kayaks, canoes, hydrobikes, and boogie boards with included PFDs and paddles. Lessons teach SUP basics in small groups for ages 13 and up. Combo adventure includes paddling and biking between Bothell and Kenmore locations.
extraNote: Prices do not include sales tax · No pro-rating on hourly rentals except SUP boards which pro-rate every half hour after first hour · Must return rental to same location · Reservations required at Bothell and Kenmore locations · Bothell Landing, Log Boom Park in Kenmore, Wilmot Gateway Park in Woodinville
